backend.scope: Coverlet application assembly including generated migrations; module view deduplicates file/line records. This unit run does not aggregate HTTP/browser/integration execution.

frontend.scope: Default V8 loaded-file report. Missing source files are explicitly listed; loaded percentages must not be called whole frontend coverage.

requirements.scope: Atomic requirements and state/risk denominators still incomplete; design families/named cases do not establish percent covered.

api.scope: Static133 registration sites not reconciled to runtime policies/complete cases; smoke pass counts are not endpoint coverage.

browser.scope: A few core/mocked journeys only; no complete flow/device/accessibility denominator.

integration.scope: Selected real PostgreSQL/proxy/data failures, not complete transaction/provider/worker coverage.
